author: New China TV
description:
#Shenzhen, the host city of #APEC 2026, is in many ways the embodiment of #China's development miracle. But its story goes far beyond the skyline.

From mangrove wetlands to bustling electronics markets, from contemporary art to everyday life in a care home, Xinhua's Miao Xiaojuan @miaoxiaojuan explores the people and ideas shaping this metropolis, and what it means to live well here.

A Miao Xiaojuan Studio Film
A Xinhua News Agency Production
title: Documentary | Shenzhen: Beyond the Skyline

author: New China TV
description:
With the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders' Meeting just around the corner, Mexican influencer Diego Ruzzarin arrives in Shenzhen, the host city of APEC 2026, to experience the buzz of the event.
Where will the meeting take place? What does the 2026 APEC "China Year" emblem symbolize? How does Asia-Pacific economic cooperation affect everyday life?
Follow Diego as he explores Shenzhen and looks ahead to #APEC 2026. #AmazingChina
title: #AmazingChina | Mexican influencer explores host city of APEC 2026

author: New China TV
description:
From Shanghai to Beijing, and now Shenzhen!
China is hosting APEC for the third time. What have the previous meetings achieved, and what should we watch for this November?
The story of China and APEC continues, as Asia-Pacific cooperation grows and evolves.
#APEC2026 #Shenzhen
title: EyesOn | China's third APEC: What to expect?

author: New China TV
description: The third batch of date palm seedlings donated by the United Arab Emirates (UAE) has arrived in Hainan, south China. The date palm, often dubbed "desert bread," is a vital cash crop native to the Middle East and North Africa. This delivery marks another milestone in bilateral agricultural cooperation between China and the UAE.
title: Eyes on Hainan | 3rd batch of UAE-donated date palm seedlings arrive in south China's Hainan

author: New China TV
description:
In 2014, Chinese President Xi Jinping called for efforts to create and fulfill an Asia-Pacific dream while hosting APEC leaders in Beijing. Over the years, he has advocated jointly promoting Asia-Pacific development as well as advancing openness and cooperation in the region.
As Shenzhen enters APEC mode, marking China's third time hosting the annual meetings, it is once again time to jointly discuss the region's development and work together toward a brighter future for the Asia-Pacific.
